requests.name: Jira Get Current User
requests.mcp_description: Return the authenticated Jira user.

requests.name: Jira Search Issues JQL
requests.mcp_description: Search Jira issues with JQL. If this endpoint's selected environment defines jira_project_key, start normal searches with project = <jira_project_key>; when unset, search across all accessible projects. Use another permitted project only when explicitly requested. search_payload must be a JSON object accepted by POST /rest/api/3/search/jql.

search_payload.description: Serialized JSON body for Jira enhanced JQL search. Use jira_project_key as the normal project when set, or search all accessible projects when unset; use another permitted project only when explicitly requested.

requests.name: Jira Get Issue
requests.mcp_description: Return a Jira issue by key or ID.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key or numeric ID, for example DEMO-123.

requests.name: Jira Create Issue
requests.mcp_description: Create a Jira issue. If this endpoint's selected environment defines jira_project_key, use it as the normal fields.project.key; when unset, specify the target project explicitly. issue_payload must be a serialized Jira Create issue JSON body; Jira Cloud rich-text descriptions use Atlassian Document Format.

issue_payload.description: Serialized JSON body for POST /rest/api/3/issue. Use jira_project_key as the normal fields.project.key when set, or specify the target project explicitly when unset; use another permitted project only when explicitly requested.

requests.name: Jira Update Issue
requests.mcp_description: Update fields on an existing Jira issue. update_payload must be a serialized Jira Edit issue JSON body.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key or numeric ID.

requests.name: Jira Get Transitions
requests.mcp_description: List workflow transitions available for a Jira issue before changing its status.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key or numeric ID.

requests.name: Jira Transition Issue
requests.mcp_description: Apply an available Jira workflow transition. transition_payload must be serialized JSON, for example {"transition":{"id":"31"}}.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key or numeric ID.

requests.name: Jira Add Worklog
requests.mcp_description: Add a worklog to a Jira issue. worklog_payload must be a serialized JSON worklog body, including timeSpent or timeSpentSeconds.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key or numeric ID.

requests.name: Jira Search Fields
requests.mcp_description: Search Jira fields by name, for example to find the custom Story Points field ID.

query.description: Text to match against Jira field names, for example story point.

requests.name: Jira List Boards
requests.mcp_description: List Jira Software boards. When this endpoint's selected environment defines jira_project_key, results are project-scoped; when unset, lists all boards accessible to the credentials. This is a normal default, not an authorization or permission restriction.

maxResults.description: Maximum boards per page (Agile maxResults). Defaults to 50 when omitted. Accepted as a native integer or decimal string.

startAt.description: 0-based offset into the board list (Agile startAt). Defaults to 0 when omitted. Accepted as a native integer or decimal string.

requests.name: Jira List Board Sprints
requests.mcp_description: List sprints on the selected board filtered by state (future, active, or closed). This is not automatically project-scoped by jira_project_key; the selected board controls the scope.

board_id.description: Jira Software board ID accepted as a native integer or decimal string.

state.description: Sprint state: future, active, or closed.

maxResults.description: Maximum sprints per page (Agile maxResults). Defaults to 50 when omitted. Accepted as a native integer or decimal string.

startAt.description: 0-based offset into the sprint list (Agile startAt). Defaults to 0 when omitted. Accepted as a native integer or decimal string.

requests.name: Jira Get Sprint
requests.mcp_description: Return a Jira Software sprint by numeric ID.

sprint_id.description: Jira Software sprint ID accepted as a native integer or decimal string.

requests.name: Jira Update Sprint
requests.mcp_description: Update a Jira Software sprint, including activating or closing it. sprint_payload must be serialized JSON, for example {"state":"active"}.

sprint_id.description: Jira Software sprint ID accepted as a native integer or decimal string.

requests.name: Jira Delete Sprint
requests.mcp_description: Permanently delete a Jira Software sprint by numeric ID. Irreversible; open issues in the sprint move to the backlog.

sprint_id.description: Jira Software sprint ID accepted as a native integer or decimal string.

requests.name: Jira Create Sprint
requests.mcp_description: Create a future Jira Software sprint on a board. sprint_payload must be serialized JSON, for example {"name":"Sprint 12","originBoardId":1,"startDate":"2026-08-03T09:00:00.000Z","endDate":"2026-08-17T17:00:00.000Z"}.

requests.name: Jira Add Issues To Sprint
requests.mcp_description: Move issues into a Jira Software sprint. issues_payload must be serialized JSON, for example {"issues":["DEMO-1","DEMO-2"]}.

sprint_id.description: Jira Software sprint ID accepted as a native integer or decimal string.

requests.name: Jira Get Sprint Issues
requests.mcp_description: List issues in the selected sprint. Prefer JQL search when filtering across boards; use this for a direct sprint membership listing. This is not automatically project-scoped by jira_project_key; the selected sprint controls the scope.

sprint_id.description: Jira Software sprint ID accepted as a native integer or decimal string.

maxResults.description: Maximum issues per page (Agile maxResults). Defaults to 50 when omitted. Accepted as a native integer or decimal string.

startAt.description: 0-based offset into the sprint issue list (Agile startAt). Defaults to 0 when omitted. Accepted as a native integer or decimal string.

requests.name: Jira Link Issue Parent
requests.mcp_description: Link a Jira issue to an epic or parent via the parent field (preferred over deprecated Epic Link). parent_payload must be serialized JSON, for example {"fields":{"parent":{"key":"DEMO-1"}}}.

issue_key.description: Child issue key or numeric ID to reparent.

parent_payload.description: Serialized JSON body with fields.parent for PUT /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}.

requests.name: Jira Add Comment
requests.mcp_description: Add a comment to a Jira issue. comment_payload must be serialized JSON; Jira Cloud bodies commonly use Atlassian Document Format under body.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key or numeric ID.

requests.name: Jira Assign Issue
requests.mcp_description: Assign a Jira issue via the dedicated assignee endpoint (more reliable than setting assignee through generic update). assignee_payload must be serialized JSON, for example {"accountId":"5b10a2844c20165700ede21g"} or {"accountId":null} to unassign.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key or numeric ID.

requests.name: Jira Get Worklog
requests.mcp_description: List worklogs for a Jira issue.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key or numeric ID.

requests.name: Jira Move Issues To Backlog
requests.mcp_description: Remove issues from sprint membership by moving them to the backlog (clears active/future sprint assignment). Supported remove-from-sprint path (max 50 issues per batch); issues_payload must be serialized JSON, for example {"issues":["DEMO-1"]}.

requests.name: Jira Search Assignable Users
requests.mcp_description: Search users assignable to a Jira issue; use accountId from results with jira-assign-issue.

query.description: Text to match display name or email.

issue_key.description: Issue key that scopes assignable-user search.
